args.message:
fix: use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money

Per FIN-212, round_money must round half to even (banker's rounding).
Replace ROUND_HALF_UP with ROUND_HALF_EVEN so 2.675 -> 2.68 and
2.665 -> 2.66, matching tests/test_money.py.

args.head: fix/money-bankers-rounding
args.title: fix: use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Change

- `src/money.py`: switch from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so that:
  - `round_money(Decimal("2.675")) == Decimal("2.68")`
  - `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")` (banker's rounding)

## Verification

- CI run `ci-0001` passed on branch `fix/money-bankers-rounding`.

Requesting review from @alex.
